notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver. 3.7 - Add History / Toxic, Ghost Rework
notes.content:
Hello, I would like to introduce an update of UNILOGUE Ver 3.7!

[h2]Addition of history function[/h2]

You can check the records of the adventures you have sent so far.
Please leave your glorious records of when you completed the game here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/0f531ed27c93aaf816018c8edccff345c4936b5f.png[/img]


[h2]Synergy adjustments[/h2]

We have made some bold adjustments to some hard-to-use synergies and characters.

[b]Toxic Synergy[/b]
Old: When attacking normally, inflicts "Poison" with a probability of
New: When damage is inflicted by a skill, "Poison" is inflicted.

[b]Ghost Synergy[/b]
Old: Additional damage to enemies with 3 or more types of negative status abnormalities
New: Additional damage depending on the number of negative conditions on the enemy.

[b]Frost Synergy[/b]
Stun time caused by Frost Synergy now adds up

[b]Wanda[/b]
Old: Weakening and mana recovery upon death status abnormalities are added to enemies
New: Increases attack power and decreases defense power. Can be stacked.

[b]Aria[/b]
Old: Damages and poisons enemies.
New: Inflicts 3 stacks of poison on enemies within range in front of you.

[b]Nina[/b]
Old: Restores enemy health and gradually absorbs HP from enemies.
New: Gradually absorbs HP from enemies in the area of effect.

Some other adjustments are being made.

[h2]Notice[/h2]

Questions about future updates can also be directed here!

[url=https://discord.gg/qyhSjbd2kY]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/DS_Darjeeling]Twitter[/url](Mainly tweets in Japanese)


Keep up the good work UNILOGUE!

notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver. 3.3 - Addition of Hard Mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm here to announce UNILOGUE Ver 3.3!

[h2]Addition of hard mode[/h2]

The most important update is the addition of Hard Mode. 
Now you can fight stronger enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/4441000714026e47a5c0e4638bbfa1fb0a91de9e.png[/img]


[h2]Character and item catalogs can now be viewed during adventures.[/h2]

We have made it possible to view the character and item catalogs at any time during the adventure.
You can check them from the Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/fdbc04adb6b78713bb4f43daf3b4f07978c95907.png[/img]

[h2]Notice[/h2]

Questions about future updates can also be directed here!

[url=https://discord.gg/qyhSjbd2kY]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/DS_Darjeeling]Twitter[/url](Mainly tweets in Japanese)


Keep up the good work UNILOGUE!

notes.title: UNILOGUE Ver. 3.3 Preview
notes.content:
Hello, from a developer whose game development has been slowed by the summer heat, here's a preview of the next version up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/09186c7c30ef77612f32464ae9649abdb18ac4e8.png[/img]


[h2]Addition of hard mode[/h2]

The biggest addition is the implementation of a hard mode. What changes in Hard Mode is simple. Enemies will be stronger!
We know from Steam results that players are really enjoying the game and that some have already cleared all the stages (thanks for playing!).
We have therefore decided to implement the hard mode earlier than planned. We have already implemented about 80% of the game and we hope to be able to release it soon (maybe next week or the week after?).


Hard mode will be available for Steam Achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/4441000714026e47a5c0e4638bbfa1fb0a91de9e.png[/img]


[h2]Character and item catalogs can now be viewed during adventures.[/h2]

For those of you just starting out in this game, we are implementing a feature that will allow you to view your character list at any time.
We are still working on the specifics of how this will be done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553940/d84ea6b6645907074c3de33bb08bc7d149a8f820.png[/img]
This screen will be available at all times.

[h2]Notice[/h2]

Questions about future updates can also be directed here!

[url=https://discord.gg/qyhSjbd2kY]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/DS_Darjeeling]Twitter[/url](Mainly tweets in Japanese)


Keep up the good work UNILOGUE!
